subject: other_people_not_current_user_or_assistant
text:
seeker: how are you today

supporter: Good, how are you?
seeker: eh

seeker: i've been better

seeker: I'm just looking back on school and i realize that i could have done much better.

supporter: What's going on?  Maybe I can help.

seeker: so, i was reflecting about my last job

seeker: sorry, not job, paper

supporter: Are you a student?  That can be difficult. 

seeker: no, i graduated with my masters last year

seeker: i was thinking back on it and it makes me sad

supporter: Congratulations on graduating.  That took a lot of hard work.  What about your paper makes you sad?
seeker: so, i was assigned a 10 page paper, which i wrote 40, that was awesome. however, my these i was supposed to write 35 or so and wrote 40 also, i just feel as though i could have added more
 
supporter: You already did way more than expected of you- 3.5 times as much.  And your paper was good enough to help you graduate.  Be proud of yourself.  You accomplished something great.
seeker: awww. thank you!

supporter: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

seeker: i think that helped, its just a good feeling. btw, i did get a 100% on both of those papers

supporter: Congratulations again!  Display that diploma with pride.  Talk to you later.  
seeker: haha, thank you. my masters did get my this job in this field too
